title: Paychex Flex pricing - Last public rates $39-$47/month base plus $3-$5/employee
clean_text: The last publicly available Paychex Flex pricing showed Essentials at $39/month base plus $5/employee/month (designed for businesses under 20 employees, including payroll, tax administration, and workforce/risk management), and both Select and Pro at $47/month base plus $3/employee/month, with Select adding a learning management system. Paychex has since taken pricing offline entirely; current customers must contact a sales representative for a custom quote based on employee count, payroll frequency, state tax complexity, and whether HR/benefits/PEO services are bundled in.

meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription, base plus per-employee, custom quote
